## Bio

Ana Topasna is a 3rd year PhD Candidate in the Human Genomics and Genetics program at Johns Hopkins. She is interested in genetic disorders that exhibit allelic heterogeneity and how personalized medicine can be used to tailor small molecule therapies. Her thesis work focuses on understanding the genetic causes of non-CF bronchectasis and investigating novel therapeutics for intronic CF variants. 

Outside of work Ana enjoys rock climbing 🧗, snowboarding 🏂 and reading 📜.
